description:
Candidate should have 7+ years’ experience. Excellent  in HTML 5.0 and CSS (hands on and should be able to showcase websites that he/she has developed). Candidate should understand Javascript concepts and should have hands on experience with market standards such as JS MVC frameworks such as angular.js, backbone.js, can.js etc…
 
 Essential Responsibilities
 Job Responsibilities:
 • Quality experiences that work across browsers and devices
 • Intuitive user interfaces/experiences
 • Facilitate continuous testing of interfaces and experiences
 • Quality code using best-in-class practices
 • Designs will be responsive and elements will be SEO friendly
 • Platform TBD (e.g. Wordpress, DNN, Dot Net Nuke, etc.)
 • The resource will be working on multiple efforts including the development of a new microsite design will be highly user friendly and compatible with latest technologies and latest browsers working directly for the Communication Manager
 • Works within the Agile/Scrum process to develop software and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement
 • Collaborate with marketing , design, other business teams and customers to understand requirements and define software interfaces/experiences
 • Work to develop common, rich user interfaces and reusable components for enterprise-class websites and ecommerce sites
 • Write quality, testable, maintainable, and well-documented code

 
 • Expert with HTML5
 • Expert with CSS – Especially CSS3
 • JavaScript MVC
 o Core skills required: Javascript, HTML5, CSS3, JS MVC Frameworks, JS libraries
 o CSS – especially CSS3
 • Experience with JS
 • Experience with jQuery
 • Experience with Backbone
 • Experience with one or more: Wordpress, DNN, Dot Net Nuke, etc.
 • Experience with AJAX, XML handling and JSON handling
 • Experience with high-performance, open source web technologies 
 • Experience in developing web application for heavy volume sites
 • Experience with Oracle SQL 
 • Release management experience
 • Experience with multi-business unit integrations
 • Experience with workflow management systems

 Ask IT Consulting Inc.| 33 Peachtree St., Suite 100 |Holtsville, NY 11742
 Website: http://www.askitc.com/
